cards.exampleMeaning: The appointment of the next Chief Justice rests with the President.

cards.meaning: and even; extending up a scale (nouns, numbers)
cards.example: 房地产投资大幅下滑，乃至拖累了整体投资。
cards.examplePinyin: Fángdìchǎn tóuzī dàfú xiàhuá, nǎizhì tuōlěi le zhěngtǐ tóuzī.
cards.exampleMeaning: Property investment fell sharply, even dragging down total investment.
cards.note: 书面语/formal connective that stretches a list to its extreme end. Contrast 甚至 (intensifier, often with 都/也, more spoken) — 乃至 sits in written reports and links nouns/numbers.

cards.example: 内需疲软，好在出口依然强劲。
cards.examplePinyin: Nèixū píruǎn, hǎozài chūkǒu yīrán qiángjìn.
cards.exampleMeaning: Domestic demand is soft, but fortunately exports remain strong.
cards.note: 口语/informal connective, opens the clause that rescues the situation. Contrast 幸亏 (stresses a narrow escape, pairs with 才/不然) — 好在 is milder.
cards.tiesTo: China Q3 GDP: exports carry growth
